dossier.valuation_method: Probability-weighted, time-discounted scenario analysis (rNPV) at 17% cost of equity with base-rate-anchored weights and a bottom-up acquihire branch; anchored by an asset/liquidation floor, cross-checked vs edge-AI M&A comps and a distressed revenue multiple.
dossier.thesis_summary: Pre-scale, going-concern edge-AI chip company whose 2025 '20x growth' is low-margin GPU-server resale to two newly-formed China counterparties (about 88% of revenue) under multiple securities-fraud investigations. Novel but uncompetitive GSP silicon (about 2.3 vs Hailo's about 10 TOPS/W), about $15-20M/quarter burn, no financing backstop, about 65% dilution to survive 24 months. Value is a binary option: probability-weighted PV of wipeout (35%), survival (38%), bottom-up acquihire (19%), scale (8%) = about $0.36/share above a melting about $0.25 floor.
key_value_drivers: Cash burn and the about 65% mandatory dilution
Strategic acquihire value of the GSP IP/team (the swing input)
Gross-margin inflection from about 10% resale to product economics
key_risks: Revenue concentration in possibly-fictitious counterparties; team-only acquihire impairing common
what_would_change_my_mind: Confirmation NeoTensr/Starshine revenue is real and fully collected
A named production design win at scale
A funded next-gen tape-out on an advanced node
A committed financing facility or strategic-acquirer interest above team-only level

gaps: Truly marginal at this point: the ~150-engineer headcount underpinning the acquihire branch is inferred from R&D spend rather than pulled from a filing/headcount disclosure — confirming it directly (10-K/LinkedIn) would fully nail down the swing input, though it is already bounded by the disclosed sensitivity.

The retention-package and securities-litigation deductions in the acquihire bridge are applied qualitatively to reach the ~$180M net-to-common; quantifying each (e.g., a stated retention pool and an estimated litigation reserve) would make an already-sound derivation fully explicit. Neither item changes the conclusion.
